title: Ehhh
text: Okay app, no option to export or any other review options for your invoices. Very basic. Not built for scale.

title: Invoice Generator
text: Was supposed to be free, but then once you start doing invoices, you can no longer see them unless you download another app called Soho, which is in app purchases for you to be able to see the invoices. What a waste of time would not recommend this.

title: Stupid App
text: Don’t Use. It assigns you an email address that you have no access to and the Capcha features isn’t worth trying to figure out the garbled letters and numbers.

title: Not free
text: Take at least 30 minutes to get anything and you have to give them all your personal information. Waste of time.

title: Logo needed
text: Even though the app is very easy to use, I am unable to upload my business logo. I will have to use a different app to meet my needs.

title: Worst app ever! DONT EVEN BOTHER WASTING YOUR TIME
text: This app is complete junk. By far the worse app ive come across for invoice generating. Could not even complete 1 invoice in the span of 3 weeks. Nobody has time for this nonsense. If I could give -5 stars thats what this app deserves!!!!!

title: What a joke
text:
Won’t let me sign in after generation invoices. Never signed out. Makes me look like an idiot in front of customers. Simple and professional invoices they call themselves.
Now there’s an enigma wrapped in an enigma

title: Not User friendly
text: There is not an option for pictures to add for invoices and when you click on the invoice that you mark paid then it stays in the same folder.
